title: ziftbook: appointments in three taps
description: Book an appointment in three taps, as a guest or with an account. Coming soon for small businesses and the people who visit them.
headline: Appointments, booked in three taps.
lede: Pick a service, choose a time, done. Book as a guest in seconds, or create an account and every visit after that is quicker still.
previewLabel: Example booking: a manicure on Thursday at 14:30, confirmed in three steps.
client1: Book as a guest. No password, no app to install.
client2: With an account your details are remembered, so booking your usual again takes one tap.
client3: Every appointment in one place, even with different businesses.
client4: A reminder before you go, and a link to move or cancel if plans change.
business1: Add your services, prices and how long each one takes. The gap between appointments is worked out for you.
business2: Set working hours for everyone on your team and block time off in a moment.
business3: Approve each request yourself, or let bookings confirm on their own.
business4: Take a deposit, full payment upfront or payment on the day, with cancellation rules you decide.
business5: Stays in sync with Google Calendar, so nobody gets booked twice.
